statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail is 19% while Stress is 99%.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold; the mapped public policy state is EA_ON. Stress is extreme because weekend headline and reopening-gap risk are unusually high.
headline: Low Tail, extreme weekend stress before NQ reopens
body: NQ futures are weekend-closed, so no current tape can confirm persistent extension, shallow pullbacks, or failed retracements. Friday's Nasdaq rose 0.96% and VIX fell to 15.88, but the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown and worsening Bab el-Mandeb disruption create severe energy and reopening-gap risk. The evidence supports extreme Stress without a Tail block.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail moved from the watch band late Friday into the low band after the cash close, while Stress stayed extreme. By Saturday, NQ was closed and Tail held at 19% as geopolitical and energy risk intensified without new price-path evidence.
outlookSummary: The entire 24-hour forecast ends before NQ futures reopen on Sunday. Tail therefore remains low at 19% because no live one-way path can be observed, while Stress stays extreme at 98-99% on unresolved Saudi pipeline, Red Sea and broader Gulf risks. The decisive next evidence will be the reopening gap, retracement depth and cross-asset alignment.
